mechanism: Rasagiline (MAOI) combined with cenobamate may increase CNS depression and potentially affect serotonergic activity; cenobamate also induces CYP3A4 which metabolizes rasagiline.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, serotonergic effects, and rasagiline efficacy; consider dose adjustment of rasagiline if cenobamate is initiated or discontinued.
